spring-petclinic.about: The Spring team's own sample app: JPA, Thymeleaf, caching, Actuator. Last Spring Boot 2.7 commit before the move to Boot 3. Not written by us.

spring-petclinic-rest.about: The Spring team's REST sample with Spring Security and generated OpenAPI code. Spring Boot 2.6.2, the last Boot 2 commit before the Boot 3 move. Not written by us; added as a second held-out app and run once, untuned.
